field_semantics.force_residual: WheelDynamicsState.force_residual is WheelStep.residual. In the coupled path it is max(force_error, brake_error), where force_error is contact-force vector mismatch in N and brake_error is brake torque residual divided by wheel radius in N. It is not a separately stored pure contact-force residual.
field_semantics.grip_budget: force_grip is computed at the force phase from that solve load and friction coefficient; check hypot(fx,fy)-force_grip strictly > 0 with no added tolerance. sample_grip is the later observe-phase budget and is not substituted.
field_semantics.road_dissipation: each WheelStep road_dissipation = sub_dt * dot(force, patch slip); vehicle_tires accumulates this signed value across substeps in the tick. No clamping applied.
field_semantics.patch_speed_reconstruction: contact_force defines patch=(slip_x-rate_x, slip_y-rate_y), patch_kappa=patch_x/denominator, patch_alpha=atan2(-patch_y,denominator), denominator=max(abs(vx),slip_speed). Thus reconstruct patch magnitude as hypot(kappa*denominator, denominator*tan(alpha)).
field_semantics.residual_work_bound: The requested 0.001 N * |patch speed| * dt is calculated at the saved final substep sample using both body dt and substep dt. This is an endpoint proxy only; the exact bound for accumulated per-tick road energy is unknown because intermediate substep patch speeds and residuals are not present in these row fields.
field_semantics.thresholds: No thresholds were changed and no negative road_dissipation values were clamped.
